title: Imiphefumlo yoMsele
intro: Ubuyela kwixesha apho umlawuli ongenalusini wayefuna ukuzinikela ngokupheleleyo koothixo bobuxoki. Uluntu oluncinci lwemiphefumlo ezinikeleyo lwala, lwaza lwajongana nesohlwayo esiqatha kangangokuba lwaba luqalekiso ngonaphakade. Ibali labo livakala kwiQuran njengobungqina bokholo olungagungqiyo. Ngaba ungalibona eli qela liqinileyo?
clues: Sasihlala kwilizwe elaliphantsi kolawulo lomlawuli owayefuna ukunqulwa koothixo bobuxoki.
Uluntu lwethu lwajamelana nentshutshiso enzima ngenxa yokukholelwa kwethu ku-Allah kuphela
Umlawuli wayalela ukuba kumbiwe umsele omkhulu uze utshiswe ngamalangatye avuthayo.
Ngenxa yokuba salile ukulahla ukholo lwethu, saphoswa kuloo mngxuma uvuthayo ngamnye emva komnye
Ibali lethu laba yinxalenye yeQuran, kwaye abo babesitshutshisa baqalekiswa ngonaphakade.
I-surah ebhala ubunzima bethu ibizwa ngegama leempawu ezinkulu zesibhakabhaka

outcome.label: Isiphumo Sethu
options: Sabulawa ngenxa yokholo kwaye abatshutshisi baqalekiswa ngonaphakade
Saguqulwa saba ziinkawu ngenxa yokungathobeli kwethu umthetho
Isikhalo esinye esibuhlungu satshabalalisa ubomi bethu
outcome.answer: Sabulawa ngenxa yokholo kwaye abatshutshisi baqalekiswa ngonaphakade

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
